summary: Having a high damage value breaks and crashes the game
description: /give @p minecraft:wolf_armor[minecraft:damage=2147483647] equip it on a wolf hit the wolf shear the armor off put it in an item frame /data get entity @e[type=minecraft:item_frame,sort=nearest,limit=1] if you try to save the game by going to the pause menu the game crashes
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Use the command `/give @p minecraft:wolf_armor[minecraft:damage=2147483647]` to give yourself wolf armor with a high damage value.
3. Equip the wolf armor on a wolf.
4. Hit the wolf to shear the armor off.
5. Put the sheared armor into an item frame.
6. Use the command `/data get entity @e[type=minecraft:item_frame,sort=nearest,limit=1]` to retrieve data from the item frame.
7. Open the pause menu.
8. Attempt to save the game.
9. Observe that the game crashes.
Observed Behavior: When executing the command `/give @p minecraft:wolf_armor{Damage:2147483647}`, the player receives a wolf armor item with an exceptionally high damage value. Upon equipping this armor on a wolf and subsequently shearing it, the armor is removed from the wolf's inventory. If the player places the sheared wolf armor into an item frame, the item frame successfully displays the armor. However, attempting to save the game by accessing the pause menu results in a game crash. The crash appears to be linked to the high damage value of the wolf armor, as regular damage values do not trigger this behavior. Upon investigation using the command `/data get entity @e[type=minecraft:item_frame,sort=nearest,limit=1]`, the game fails to handle the high damage value appropriately, leading to instability and ultimately crashing the game when the save operation is initiated. This issue is reproducible under the specified conditions and poses significant risks for players attempting to save their progress after interacting with the affected wolf armor.
Expected Behavior: When executing the command to give a wolf armor with a high damage value, the game should allow the player to equip the armor on the wolf without crashing. Upon shearing the armor off the wolf and placing it in an item frame, the game should function normally, allowing players to save their progress via the pause menu without any crashes occurring. The game should handle high damage values gracefully, ensuring a stable experience.
